integration_connections_company_uq.name: integration_connections_company_uq

integration_connections_one_door.name: integration_connections_one_door

portal_link_keys_revocation_reasoned.name: portal_link_keys_revocation_reasoned

price_list_lines_target.value: stock_item_id IS NOT NULL OR item_group IS NOT NULL

price_list_lines_slab_order.name: price_list_lines_slab_order
price_list_lines_slab_order.value: min_qty IS NULL OR max_qty IS NULL OR min_qty < max_qty

price_lists_effective_order.name: price_lists_effective_order
price_lists_effective_order.value: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_from <= effective_to

attendance_period_locks_unlock_has_reaso.value: unlocked_at IS NULL OR (unlock_reason IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim(unlock_reason)) >= 10)

comp_off_credits_pending_lapse_idx.name: comp_off_credits_pending_lapse_idx

leave_balances_closing_is_the_sum.value: closing = opening + accrued - availed + adjusted + carried_forward

attendance_adjustments_moves_something.name: attendance_adjustments_moves_something
attendance_adjustments_moves_something.value: adjusted_in IS NOT NULL OR adjusted_out IS NOT NULL

regularizations_system_reason_optional.name: regularizations_system_reason_optional
regularizations_system_reason_optional.value: origin = 'SYSTEM' OR reason IS NOT NULL

shift_assignments_range_ordered.name: shift_assignments_range_ordered
shift_assignments_range_ordered.value: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from

grn_lines_rejection_reasoned.name: grn_lines_rejection_reasoned
grn_lines_rejection_reasoned.value: rejected_qty = 0 OR rejection_reason IS NOT NULL

purchase_order_lines_received_le_ordered.name: purchase_order_lines_received_le_ordered
purchase_order_lines_received_le_ordered.value: received_qty >= 0 AND rejected_qty >= 0 AND received_qty + rejected_qty <= quantity

sales_document_lines_dispatched_le_invoi.name: sales_document_lines_dispatched_le_invoiced
sales_document_lines_dispatched_le_invoi.value: dispatched_qty >= 0 AND dispatched_qty <= (CASE WHEN free_of_charge THEN packed_qty ELSE invoiced_qty END)
